title: 0RAT0R's Dark GUI
description: Small texture-pack on a dark theme by 0RAT0R!
body:
## A simple **texture-pack** on a dark theme. Changes **almost** every GUI in the game!

- This texture pack changes almost all the GUI in the game to a dark bluish color with square corners. The buttons are also changed to a dark bluish color, and when you hover the mouse, the outline color changes to green!

- No [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) required to play

- Optional: for a comfortable game, install [Raised](https://modrinth.com/mod/raised)

![Main menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/006cc724f95b8f17d9015268c844399159006686_0.webp)
